bible.title: BLUELINE — M0 Previz · r4ng3r
bible.note: 120@24 -> 12 frames/beat (integer) -> beats land on whole frames; the determinism pair from Track III.

shots.action: Ranger stands small in the misty forest. Held stillness — the calm before.
Push in to three-quarter. She senses something off-frame.
Over her shoulder: the threat. Guard up. Blocking dictates the frame.
Low up-angle. She turns into it — heroic, looming against the sky.
THE DROP. She draws the bow. Speed-lines ignite — the flow field is the wind.
Coil. Everything compresses to the held breath at full draw.
Release. The field goes full — the arrow rides the wind across frame.
Aftermath. She lowers the bow. The field settles. Hold to the bar.
